newsitem.title: UK: Light up your lamb and the fox will flee.
newsitem.headline: Light up your lamb and the fox will flee.

text.p: British farmers have found a novel new way to outsmart hungry foxes -- with lambs that glow in the dark.
Researchers discovered that coating the lambs with phosphorescent paint discourages hungry predators prowling the fields during the lambing season.
The paint is also laced with a foul-tasting substance which puts off any fox in search of a speedy meal.

"Foxes will quickly come to associate the light with a terrible taste. It has a taste so horrible that even a hungry fox will never become accustomed to it," said a spokesman for the manufacturers of the new Repel spray.
